recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多核巨細胞，細胞核沿周邊排成馬蹄形／花環狀（Langhans 型巨細胞），周圍有核呈細長鞋底狀的類上皮組織球聚集，形成肉芽腫；本視野未見乾酪樣壞死。
features: Multinucleated Langhans-type giant cell with nuclei arranged peripherally in a horseshoe/wreath pattern and central eosinophilic cytoplasm
Second giant cell in the lower left
Surrounding epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, pale, slipper-shaped nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Loose admixed lymphocytes and a fibrillary pale stroma replacing normal hematopoietic marrow in this field
No caseous necrosis in this field; bony trabeculae at the edges and a dark pink artifactual fragment
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy at medium power shows a granulomatous focus replacing the normal hematopoietic tissue. It is composed of sheets of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated pale nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed lymphocytes, and at least two multinucleated Langhans-type giant cells with peripherally arranged nuclei. No caseous necrosis is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with non-caseating granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and clinical correlation are required, with tuberculosis, other infections, sarcoidosis, drugs, and lymphoma-associated granulomas in the differential.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and AFB on ZN stain or culture, although marrow granulomas may be non-caseating and AFB-negative.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well-formed, and non-necrotizing with asteroid or Schaumann bodies, and require exclusion of infection.
Fungal granulomas contain small yeasts demonstrable on GMS or PAS stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+ within a mixed inflammatory background.
